# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Added regression coverage for the habitat-registry refresh contract across scenario startup, startup overrides, `Engine::from_parts`, action-driven hourly updates, daily updates, and current-schema save loading. The checked-out base already contains the central `refresh_habitat_registry` wiring in core/state/save/scenario paths; this stage locked those paths down with tests so stale serialized habitat data is now guarded against regression.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the habitat-registry refresh paths and confirmed the checked-out base already refreshes derived habitat state in constructors, engine assembly, scenario materialization/overrides, daily updates, actions, and save/load boundaries.
2. [Completed] Added `tank_core` regressions for stale-registry repair in `Engine::from_parts`, post-trim hourly stepping, daily-update/filter-clogging refresh, and current-schema save-load repair.
3. [Completed] Added `tank_scenarios` regressions asserting `state.habitat_registry == compute_habitat_registry(&state)` after normal materialization and after full startup overrides.
4. [Completed] Ran the targeted validation suites covering the new habitat-registry and save-load regressions.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_registry --test save_load` passed (27 habitat tests, 22 save/load tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios --test materialization --test startup_overrides` passed (8 materialization tests, 4 startup-override tests).

## Outstanding Risks

- Full workspace validation was not run; coverage here is limited to the targeted `tank_core` and `tank_scenarios` regression suites.
